  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## Radiation Protection Products

Barrier Technologies® is America’s leading manufacturer of **radiation protection products**. We are
committed to continual innovation and serving the medical industry by producing superior **radiation
shielding products** using high quality of **radiation shielding **materials.

## Our Radiation Protection Products

We control the quality of our products by manufacturing everything in-house. From metal fabrication
to fabric manufacturing and product assembly, all our **x ray** radiation products are created
within our facilities.

Our industry-leading products include lightweight lead-free aprons, [velcro-free thyroid
collars][29], protective gloves, leaded eye protection, [mobile lead shields][30], and many more
radiation safety products.

## Innovation in Radiation Protection Technology

Barrier Technologies’ tenacious drive to innovate is one of the qualities that sets us apart from
other radiation shield manufacturers. From leadership to engineering, every tier of our company is
motivated to develop new solutions to problems within our sphere of the medical industry.

### Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ Technology Products

Two powerful examples of our commitment to innovation are our Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ proprietary
products:
* **Ultraflex™** is an outer material for our aprons, vests, and mobile shields. Unlike traditional
  nylon, which is porous and can’t be washed, we engineered Ultraflex™ to be an antibacterial and
  stain-free fabric — helping medical personnel maintain a sterile environment.
* **MagnaGuard™** is a patented magnetic closure we developed to eliminate the use of velcro on
  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

If you are dissatisfied with your current **radiation protection products**, contact our team and
inquire about our customization services.

## Radiation Protection Products Made in USA

From lead shields to protective eyewear, Barrier Technologies is your one-stop-shop for all things
**radiation shielding**. Our catalog includes everything necessary to build a robust, easy-to-clean
radiation protection suit:

### [Protective Aprons][31]

We offer an expansive variety of lead and lead-free aprons that can be customized to meet the unique
needs of your medical organization. Don’t have time to wait for a custom order? Then order from our
Ready To Go line of aprons — a selection of Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ equipped aprons that ship
within 24 hours of your order.

### [Radiation Protection Gloves][32]

Our lead-free and powder-free Secure Touch® gloves empower your physicians with the highest level of
**radiation shielding** in the industry. Textured fingers and palms improve grip and we’ve designed
the gloves with curved fingers and a hypoallergenic internal coating to maximize comfort.

### [Radiation Protective Eyewear][33]

Our vast catalog of leaded glasses provide the highest lead content in the industry and can be
delivered in your exact prescription. In contrast to foreign-made eyewear, our lenses don’t yellow
over time and can be coated with an anti-reflective and anti-fog coating for maximum clarity.

# Compassionate Patient Care

For more than 60 years, Hastings Radiology has been associated with quality, professionalism, and
compassion.

# Professional & Focused

We are always changing and adapting to new imaging technology, but our core values will never
change.

# Expert Imaging Interpretation

At Hastings Radiology, we provide the highest level of medical imaging services to central Nebraska
and north central Kansas using leading-edge technology and the highest level of imaging expertise.

### Hastings Radiology Associates, PC

At Hastings Radiology, we provide the highest level of medical imaging services to central Nebraska
and north central Kansas using leading-edge technology and the highest level of imaging expertise.
Our reputation for clinical excellence is the result of our scope of services, our prompt turnaround
time, the knowledge and skill of our affiliated hospitals and clinics, and compassionate care for
patients. For more than 60 years, Hastings Radiology has been associated with quality,
professionalism, and compassion. We are always changing and adapting to new imaging technology, but
our core values will never change.


#### Our Mission

Provide imaging interpretation and expertise; collaborate with other healthcare providers and
entities in a professional manner; and focus on patients with care and compassion.

#### Our Vision

Maintain expertise on all and upcoming imaging technologies; focus on prompt service to patients and
healthcare providers; and provide radiation safety and protection.

#### Nuclear Medicine

Includes bone scans, PET scans, cardiac stress tests, kidney scans, ventilation and perfusion scans,
and gastric emptying exams.

**[Learn More][54]**

#### Interventional Radiology

Includes pain management, image guided biopsy, abscess drainage, throacentesis, paracentesis, IVC
filter placement, nephrostomy tubes, ureter stents, lumbar punctures, and myelograms.

**[Learn More][55]**

#### Bone Density

Bone Densitometry (dual-energy-x-ray-absorptiometry or DEXA) is considered to be "The Gold Standard"
for diagnosing osteoporosis or bone loss.

**[Learn More][56]**

#### MRI

Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is one of the safest, most comfortable imaging techniques
available. MRI uses a magnetic field instead of radiation to obtain images of the body.

**[Learn More][57]**

#### Breast Biopsy

Current estimates say that one in eight women will experience breast cancer during their lifetime.
Mammography is the best test available for finding small breast cancers.

**[Learn More][58]**

#### Digital Mammography

Mammography is a specific type of imaging that uses a low-dose x-ray system for examination of the
breasts. Most medical experts agree that successful treatment of breast cancer is linked to early
diagnosis.

**[Learn More][59]**

#### Teleradiology

Hastings Radiology Associates has a long history of service to hospitals, clinics, and imaging
centers via remote teleradiology.

**[Learn More][60]**

#### Breast Tomosynthesis

Breast tomosynthesis, also called three-dimensional (3-D) mammography and digital breast
tomosynthesis (DBT), is an advanced form of breast imaging where multiple images of the breast from
different angles are captured and reconstructed ("synthesized") into a three-dimensional image set.

**[Learn More][61]**

#### Women’s Imaging

Hastings Radiology Associates features the most comprehensive dedicated Women's Imaging center in
the region.

**[Learn More][62]**

1

## Book an appointment

preferred clinic, date, and time. It’s convenient and saves time waiting on the phone. Available for
most scans.

2

Do you need to reschedule? Our convenient self-service portal allows you to easily reschedule or
cancel your appointment, in just a few clicks.

[Manage appointments][51]

## View your images

View, download and share your images on your phone. Access your images via an SMS link sent after
your scan is received by your referring practitioner. View your report via this link 7 days after
your referrer receives it. 

[Find out more][52]

When our radiologist has finalised your results, I-MED will send a report directly to your referring
practitioner. It is important to speak with your health practitioner about your results, to
understand what they mean and complete follow-up treatment.

## Purview FAQs

What does Purview offer?

Purview provides secure, cloud-based technology that helps organizations access, organize, and share
medical images and records — turning complex clinical information into insight that powers better
decisions.

What’s the difference between Purview Image™ and Expert View™?

[**Purview Image™**][35] focuses on medical image management — upload, view, share, and store DICOM
studies in the cloud.

**[Expert View][36]™** supports full case collaboration, including records, communication,
workflows, and second opinion programs.

Who typically uses Purview?

Purview supports any organization that is looking to access or share medical imaging or entire
patient cases remotely. Purview users are diverse, ranging from specialty provider groups,
hospitals, payer/employer networks, concierge medicine, professional athletes, virtual health
programs, medical legal teams, researchers and veterinarians.

Can I share studies directly from one PACS to another PACS with Purview Image™?
Use the FAQ section of your site to answer those routine questions that always come up and need to
be answered. This is a great way to tell us more about what you can offer, fill in some details that
might intrigue us, and show us how knowledgeable and helpful you can be.
Is Purview secure and HIPAA compliant?

Yes. Purview is built on HIPAA-aligned infrastructure with independently examined SOC 2® controls,
role-based permissions, and encrypted data transfer.

Do users need special software or downloads?

No. Purview's software runs in the browser and works on virtually any device, including desktops,
tablets, and mobile.

Can Purview support remote reads and second opinions?

Absolutely. Purview is designed to help specialists review cases from anywhere, collaborate with
peers, and deliver timely reports.

Does Purview integrate with our existing systems?

Purview is designed to complement your current infrastructure and can integrate with many systems
including EHRs, practice management systems, websites and web forms, PACS environments, and other
clinical workflows.

Can we use both Purview Image and Expert View together?

Yes. Many organizations use Purview Image for imaging logistics and Expert View to manage referrals,
interest in consultations, records reviews and destination health programs.

How do we get started?

The best way to get started is by booking an introductory call or a personalized demo by [filling
out the form here][37]. Our team will learn about your goals and workflow and recommend the right
solution.

deliver the highest level of care and best possible outcomes for your patients.

## Catching Errors: Why Independent QA Matters

[Patient Safety Starts Here][59]

*1*
  A single monitor chamber was the source of fluctuating linac outputs. Daily QA^{TM} 3 caught it,
  protecting patients.¹

*~10%*
  A patient's spinal cord was overdosed by ~10%. The precise reason why was caught by SunCHECK^{TM}
  Patient.²

*52*
  A year of weekly trajectory file measurements on 2 linacs found no errors. Concurrent EPID-based
  data caught many.³

*>1 mm*
  “It has been clinically observed the log-file derived leaf positions can differ from their actual
  position by >1 mm.”⁴

**SunCHECK v5.0 and the AVa Phantom are not available for sale in all markets. CE mark pending.* The
AVa Phantom is patent-pending.*



*¹ T. McCaw, et al., When a Good Monitor Chamber Goes Bad: Diagnosing Atmospheric Communication of a
Sealed Monitor Chamber, AAPM 2018
² Sun Nuclear SunCHECK user internal testing
³ A. Agnew et al., Monitoring daily MLC positional errors using trajectory log files and EPID
measurements for IMRT and VMAT Deliveries, Phys. Med. Biol. 59, (2014)
^{4 }B. Neal, et al., A clinically observed discrepancy between image-based and log-based MLC
positions, Med Phys. 43, 2933 (2016)*

[Patient Safety Starts Here][59]

*1*
  A single monitor chamber was the source of fluctuating linac outputs. Daily QA^{TM} 3 caught it,
  protecting patients.¹

*~10%*
  A patient's spinal cord was overdosed by ~10%. The precise reason why was caught by SunCHECK^{TM}
  Patient.²

*52*
  A year of weekly trajectory file measurements on 2 linacs found no errors. Concurrent EPID-based
  data caught many.³

*>1 mm*
  “It has been clinically observed the log-file derived leaf positions can differ from their actual
  position by >1 mm.”⁴
